limits: Job elapsed time includes setup and teardown; it is not CPU time, billed cost or agent idle time.
Parallel job durations are summed, not added to delivery latency.
Pre-job delay includes scheduling/setup latency, not a measured queue-only interval.
Cancelled time and same-head push/PR pairs are investigation candidates, not automatically wasted or equivalent proof.
Unfinished jobs are censored observations, not zero-duration successes; missing timestamps are counted separately.
